snippet.title: Shark Dentist - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From LA 2026
snippet.description:
A Gameplay trailer for Shark Dentist. Shark Dentist is a unique horror roguelike where you play as a shark dentist. Your task is to treat the teeth of giant predators in a dark clinic while avoiding their deadly aggression. Balance tactics, luck, and limited resources to heal your patient without losing your own life. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
